ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram. The right side is labeled “Freshwater shrimp” (freshwater shrimp), and the top is labeled “Brown trout” (brown trout). The green arrow points from the freshwater shrimp to the brown trout, indicating that the brown trout will prey on the freshwater shrimp. Reasoning: In a food web, if the number of a certain predator increases, the number of the prey it preys on usually decreases. Because the brown trout preys on the freshwater shrimp, an increase in the number of brown trout will lead to a decline in the number of freshwater shrimp.
